intent: Answer multilingual buyer questions from the product/policy KB with citations and low-confidence escalation; channel-aware tone [Amazon / Shopify / TikTok Shop / Shein / Temu].

metadata.name: Ecommerce Customer FAQ
metadata.description: Multilingual buyer-question Q&A from product/policy KB with citations and low-confidence escalation.
metadata.rationale: Baseline ecommerce knowledge-base archetype. Exercises trigger / retrieval / llm / output and llm.output_schema. Default deep-coverage #1 for Phase 1 per PRD §1 (ecommerce-primary wedge).

nodes.rationale: Manual entry; this archetype is interactive — invoked per buyer message.
Pull top-K candidate passages from the merged product + policy KB before LLM ranking.
Cheap re-rank pass to narrow 20 → 5; reduces tokens for the answer step and lets us threshold confidence.
nodes.system_prompt: You re-rank candidate passages by relevance to the buyer query. Return only the indices and a confidence score.

nodes.rationale: Final answer in the buyer's locale, with citations by source index. No compensation promises beyond stated policy.
nodes.system_prompt: Answer the buyer's query using only the provided KB context. Cite by source index. Do not promise specific refund/compensation amounts beyond policy. Reply in buyer_locale if provided, else infer from query.

nodes.rationale: Bind workflow outputs; confidence is the raw rerank score (0.0–1.0). The boolean needs_escalation is derived from a condition node introduced in Phase 1.5 once the SOW/operator-configured threshold is locked.
